item.name: Bitcoin Suisse (Europe) AG
item.description: The MiCAR-licensed European entity of the Bitcoin Suisse Group, based in Liechtenstein and authorised by the Financial Market Authority Liechtenstein. On 3 November 2026 it announced an expansion into the Nordics under that licence, according to its company news release, and appointed Ammy Edberg and Kristoffer Nystrøm as General Managers Nordics.

sources.title: Bitcoin Suisse Expands into the Nordics Under MiCAR Framework
